name: iura-eu
description: IURA plugin for EU law practitioners. EU legal research, legal memos, requests for a preliminary ruling (Art. 267 TFEU), actions for annulment (Art. 263 TFEU), GDPR compliance and DPIA analysis, and competition / State-aid assessments grounded in EU treaties, regulations, directives, and CJEU / ECtHR case-law — with IURA MCP integration for European legal sources.
